ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; the visible surface consists almost entirely of low-intensity dark pixels with negligible high-intensity white pixel coverage.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform dark grey intensity across the visible surface; mapped with distinct low-intensity black linear streaks primarily oriented vertically on the right lobe and diagonally on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 65-degree interior angle and significant indentation depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serration pattern; the trailing edge boundary is characterized by continuous jagged peaks and valleys from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of well-defined vertical dark rake marks on the right lobe; unaligned diagonal dark linear disruptions on the outer portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily eroded and jagged trailing edge indicating significant cumulative physical trauma or wear; multiple distinct rake marks present on the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely frayed and irregular distal tips, displaying a high degree of unique morphological erosion.
